headline: Gemini 3.8 Live Challenges OpenAI's GPT-Live in Speech-to-Speech Models
summary: Google has launched Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, models that outperform OpenAI's GPT-Live in speech-to-speech tasks. This competition is driving innovation and potentially lowering costs in the AI market.
whyItMatters: It intensifies the race for market dominance in speech-to-speech models, impacting pricing and capabilities in the AI industry.
